:::{#sol-loocv}

1. $32 / 32 = 1$ car per fold.
2. One model per fold, so $32$ models,
   each fitted to the $32 - 1 = 31$ other cars.
3. No.
   With one car per fold,
   every assignment of cars to folds produces the same 32 fits,
   only numbered differently,
   and @eq-cv-estimate does not depend on the numbering.
   Unlike @exm-kfold-mtcars,
   the estimate is not random.

:::
